message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has provided a list of available slots for Elena and David. I need to compare these with the availability of Priya and Marcus that I've already determined.

Here are the slots Brad suggested:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 15:00, 15:30

Now I'll check these against the calendars of Priya and Marcus.

Monday at 11:00: Priya has "Travel", Marcus is free. No.
Monday at 11:30: Priya has "Contract review", Marcus has "Busy". No.

Tuesday at 09:00: Priya has "Board prep", Marcus has "Recruiting call". No.
Tuesday at 09:30: Priya has "Partner lunch", Marcus has "Litigation strategy". No.

Wednesday at 13:30: Priya has "Client dinner prep", Marcus has "Litigation strategy". No.

Thursday at 09:30: Priya has "Busy", Marcus has "Contract review". No.
Thursday at 14:30: Priya is free, Marcus has "Dentist appointment". No.
Thursday at 15:00: Priya has "Client dinner prep", Marcus has "Board prep". No.

Friday at 15:00: Priya has "Hiring panel", Marcus has "Travel". No.
Friday at 15:30: Priya has "Contract review", Marcus has "Busy". No.

It seems none of the slots Brad proposed are free for Priya and Marcus. This means I'll have to find all the free slots for Priya and Marcus, not just the common ones and share them with Brad.

Let's list all free 30-minute slots for Priya and Marcus.

Priya's free slots:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 13:00, 13:30
Tue: 10:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:30
Wed: 12:30, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 09:00, 10:00, 13:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00

Marcus's free slots:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 11:00, 15:00
Tue: 11:00, 13:00, 13:30, 15:30, 16:30
Wed: 09:00, 12:00, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 12:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 14:30

I'll send both lists to Brad and ask him to find a common slot.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
